The Paranormal Chronicles Podcast invites listeners into a disturbing account from West Wales with The Pembroke Dock Haunting: Terrifying Assault, a special episode exploring testimony of alleged paranormal attacks.

Hosted by bestselling author and paranormal investigator G. L. Davies, this unsettling episode introduces listeners to the case behind his book, Ghost Sex: The Violation. At its heart is an account of escalating experiences, including reported sexual assaults attributed to an unseen presence.

What would you do if you believed something unseen could hurt you? Who would you tell? And how would you explain experiences that others might struggle to accept?

Those questions give the Pembroke Dock Haunting its deeply troubling human dimension. Beyond the paranormal claims lies the fear of feeling unsafe in your own home and the difficulty of describing something that defies everyday understanding.
